definition_zh: (v) 适应；改编（常考搭配：adapt to 适应；adapt sth for 为……改编）
example_sentence: New students should adapt to the school life as soon as possible.
sentence_zh: 新生应当尽快适应校园生活。

definition_zh: (v) 采用；采纳；收养（常考搭配：adopt a method/plan 采用方法/计划）
example_sentence: Many schools have adopted new teaching methods in recent years.
sentence_zh: 近年来许多学校都采用了新式教学方法。

example_sentence: Stress will greatly affect students’ learning efficiency.
sentence_zh: 压力会极大影响学生的学习效率。

definition_zh: (v) 负担得起；提供（常考搭配：afford to do sth 负担得起做某事）
example_sentence: Few people can afford such an expensive house in big cities.
sentence_zh: 在大城市里，很少有人能买得起如此昂贵的房子。

example_sentence: We should analyze problems calmly when we meet difficulties.
sentence_zh: 遇到困境时，我们应当冷静分析问题。

definition_zh: (v) 靠近；处理 n. 方法；途径（常考搭配：approach to doing sth 做某事的方法）
example_sentence: We need a new approach to solving this difficult problem.
sentence_zh: 我们需要新方法来解决这道难题。

example_sentence: Teachers usually assess students’ progress at the end of each term.
sentence_zh: 老师通常在每学期末评估学生的学习进度。

definition_zh: (v) 帮助；协助（常考搭配：assist sb in/with sth 帮助某人做某事）
example_sentence: Volunteers assist teachers in organizing after-school activities.
sentence_zh: 志愿者协助老师开展课外活动。

example_sentence: We cannot always assume that everything will go well.
sentence_zh: 我们不能想当然地认为万事都会一帆风顺。

definition_zh: (v) 附上；重视；依恋（常考搭配：attach importance to 重视）
example_sentence: Nowadays, more people attach great importance to physical exercise.
sentence_zh: 如今，越来越多人十分重视体育锻炼。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 尝试；努力（常考搭配：attempt to do sth 尝试做某事）
example_sentence: He made every attempt to improve his English writing skills.
sentence_zh: 他竭尽全力提升自身的英语写作能力。

definition_zh: (v) 避免；避开（常考搭配：avoid doing sth 避免做某事）
example_sentence: We should avoid making careless mistakes in the exam.
sentence_zh: 考试中我们要避免犯下粗心的错误。

definition_zh: (v) 平衡 n. 平衡；余额（常考搭配：balance A and B 平衡A与B）
example_sentence: It is important to balance study and relaxation for senior high students.
sentence_zh: 高中生平衡好学习与放松至关重要。

definition_zh: (v) 受益 n. 益处（常考搭配：benefit from 从……受益；be of benefit to 对……有益）
example_sentence: Students can benefit a lot from reading English classics.
sentence_zh: 阅读英语经典著作能让学生收获良多。

definition_zh: (v) 结合；联合（常考搭配：combine A with B 将A与B结合）
example_sentence: We should combine theory with practice in our study.
sentence_zh: 学习过程中我们要做到理论结合实际。

definition_zh: (v) 集中（注意力）（常考搭配：concentrate on 专注于）
example_sentence: You must concentrate on your studies in class.
sentence_zh: 课堂上你必须专心听讲学习。

example_sentence: Playing mobile games too much consumes plenty of our spare time.
sentence_zh: 过度玩手机会耗费我们大量课余时间。

definition_zh: (v) 贡献；促成；导致（常考搭配：contribute to 有助于；导致）
example_sentence: Regular exercise contributes to good health and a strong body.
sentence_zh: 规律运动有助于强身健体。

example_sentence: This article conveys the author’s love for hometown.
sentence_zh: 这篇文章抒发了作者对家乡的热爱之情。

definition_zh: (v) 说服；使确信（常考搭配：convince sb of sth 使某人确信某事）
example_sentence: I finally convinced my parents to support my hobby.
sentence_zh: 我最终说服父母支持我的爱好。

example_sentence: Every effort you make deserves to be respected.
sentence_zh: 你付出的每一份努力都值得被尊重。

definition_zh: (v) 决定；确定（常考搭配：determine to do sth 决心做某事）
example_sentence: He determined to work harder to realize his dream.
sentence_zh: 他下定决心加倍努力，实现自己的梦想。

definition_zh: (v) 发展；培养；养成（常考搭配：develop a habit 养成习惯）
example_sentence: We should develop the habit of keeping a diary every day.
sentence_zh: 我们应当养成每日写日记的习惯。

definition_zh: (v) 致力于；奉献（常考搭配：devote oneself to doing sth 致力于做某事）
example_sentence: Many teachers devote all their time to educating students.
sentence_zh: 许多老师倾尽心血培育学生。

definition_zh: (v) 不同；有差异（常考搭配：differ from 与……不同）
example_sentence: My learning method differs from my deskmate’s.
sentence_zh: 我的学习方法和同桌的有所不同。

example_sentence: We should discard bad habits and develop good ones.
sentence_zh: 我们要摒弃陋习，养成良好习惯。

example_sentence: Students’ excellent works are displayed on the school wall.
sentence_zh: 校园墙上陈列着同学们的优秀作品。

example_sentence: The teacher distributes learning materials to every student.
sentence_zh: 老师给每位学生分发学习资料。

example_sentence: Positive attitudes should dominate our daily study and life.
sentence_zh: 积极的心态应当主导我们日常的学习与生活。

definition_zh: (v) 捐赠；捐献（常考搭配：donate sth to sb 向某人捐赠某物）
example_sentence: Many students donate books to children in mountain areas.
sentence_zh: 不少学生向山区孩子捐赠书籍。

example_sentence: Careful checking can ensure no mistakes in the exam.
sentence_zh: 仔细检查能够保证考试少出纰漏。

example_sentence: Our school established a new reading club last year.
sentence_zh: 我校去年创办了新的读书社团。

example_sentence: We need to evaluate our study state every month.
sentence_zh: 我们每月都要复盘评估自身的学习状态。

example_sentence: People’s understanding of life is evolving with time.
sentence_zh: 人们对生活的认知随着时间不断变化。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 交换；交流（常考搭配：exchange ideas 交流想法）
example_sentence: We often exchange learning experience with classmates.
sentence_zh: 我们常常和同学交流学习心得。

example_sentence: Reading can expand our horizons and enrich our minds.
sentence_zh: 阅读能够拓宽眼界、丰富思想。

definition_zh: (v) 期待；预料（常考搭配：expect to do sth 期待做某事）
example_sentence: We all expect to get good grades in the final exam.
sentence_zh: 我们都期盼期末考试能取得优异成绩。

example_sentence: The teacher patiently explains difficult knowledge points to us.
sentence_zh: 老师耐心地为我们讲解重难点知识。

example_sentence: Teenagers should keep curious and explore new things.
sentence_zh: 青少年应保持好奇心，不断探索新鲜事物。

definition_zh: (v) 暴露；使接触（常考搭配：be exposed to 接触；暴露于）
example_sentence: Being exposed to English every day helps improve oral English.
sentence_zh: 每日接触英语有助于提升口语水平。

definition_zh: (v) 聚焦 n. 焦点（常考搭配：focus on 专注于；聚焦于）
example_sentence: We should focus on improving our comprehensive ability.
sentence_zh: 我们要着力提升自身综合素养。

definition_zh: (v) 禁止；不许（常考搭配：forbid doing sth 禁止做某事）
example_sentence: Schools forbid students from using phones in class.
sentence_zh: 学校禁止学生课堂上使用手机。

example_sentence: Positive moods can generate more motivation for study.
sentence_zh: 愉悦的心情能催生更多学习动力。

example_sentence: Hard work cannot guarantee success, but it brings hope.
sentence_zh: 努力未必能保证成功，但一定会带来希望。

example_sentence: We should learn to handle pressure in senior high school.
sentence_zh: 高中生要学会排解应对压力。

definition_zh: (v) 犹豫（常考搭配：hesitate to do sth 犹豫做某事）
example_sentence: Don’t hesitate to ask teachers for help when you meet problems.
sentence_zh: 遇到难题别犹豫，及时向老师求助。

example_sentence: Never ignore small mistakes in your study process.
sentence_zh: 学习过程中切勿忽视细小的错误。

example_sentence: The teacher uses simple examples to illustrate complex rules.
sentence_zh: 老师用浅显的例子讲解复杂的规则。

definition_zh: (v) 想象；设想（常考搭配：imagine doing sth 想象做某事）
example_sentence: We can hardly imagine life without modern technology.
sentence_zh: 我们很难想象没有现代科技的生活。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 影响；冲击（常考搭配：have a great impact on 对……有巨大影响）
example_sentence: Family education has a deep impact on teenagers’ growth.
sentence_zh: 家庭教育对青少年的成长影响深远。

example_sentence: Our school has implemented new study plans this term.
sentence_zh: 本学期我校推行了全新的学习方案。

example_sentence: Keeping reading every day can greatly improve your English level.
sentence_zh: 坚持每日阅读能大幅提升英语成绩。

example_sentence: The survey indicates that most students love reading.
sentence_zh: 这项调查显示，大多数学生喜爱阅读。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 影响（常考搭配：influence sb/sth 影响某人/某物）
example_sentence: Friends’ behaviors will influence our study habits.
sentence_zh: 同伴的行为会潜移默化影响我们的学习习惯。

definition_zh: (v) 通知；告知（常考搭配：inform sb of sth 告知某人某事）
example_sentence: The monitor informed us of the time of the sports meeting.
sentence_zh: 班长通知了我们运动会的举办时间。

example_sentence: Careless exercise may injure your body.
sentence_zh: 运动时疏忽大意可能会损伤身体。

definition_zh: (v) 坚持（常考搭配：insist on doing sth 坚持做某事）
example_sentence: He insists on getting up early to recite English words.
sentence_zh: 他坚持早起背诵英语单词。

example_sentence: Excellent role models can inspire us to keep moving forward.
sentence_zh: 优秀的榜样能够激励我们奋勇前行。

example_sentence: Our classroom installed new multimedia equipment last month.
sentence_zh: 上个月我们教室新装了多媒体设备。

definition_zh: (v) 打算；计划（常考搭配：intend to do sth 打算做某事）
example_sentence: I intend to make a detailed study plan for the new term.
sentence_zh: 我打算为新学期制定详尽的学习规划。

definition_zh: (v) 包含；使参与（常考搭配：be involved in 参与；卷入）
example_sentence: Most students are involved in various after-school activities.
sentence_zh: 多数学生都参与各式各样的课外活动。

example_sentence: Don’t isolate yourself from classmates in school.
sentence_zh: 在校期间不要疏远孤立同学。

example_sentence: No difficulty can justify giving up your dreams.
sentence_zh: 任何困难都不能成为放弃梦想的借口。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 缺乏；不足（常考搭配：lack sth 缺乏某物；lack of 缺少）
example_sentence: Many students lack enough time for physical exercise.
sentence_zh: 很多学生缺少充足的体育锻炼时间。

example_sentence: Our school launched a reading promotion activity last week.
sentence_zh: 上周我校开展了读书推广活动。

example_sentence: We should maintain a positive attitude towards study.
sentence_zh: 我们对待学习要始终保持积极心态。

definition_zh: (v) 管理；设法完成（常考搭配：manage to do sth 设法做成某事）
example_sentence: She managed to finish all her homework on time.
sentence_zh: 她准时完成了全部课后作业。

example_sentence: We should minimize mistakes through careful review.
sentence_zh: 认真复盘总结，尽可能减少失误。

example_sentence: Praise can motivate students to make greater progress.
sentence_zh: 表扬能够激励学生取得更大进步。

example_sentence: We can negotiate with teammates about group work plans.
sentence_zh: 我们可以和组员商议小组任务方案。

example_sentence: We should observe school rules and regulations strictly.
sentence_zh: 我们必须严格遵守校规校纪。

example_sentence: You can obtain knowledge through continuous reading and learning.
sentence_zh: 坚持阅读学习就能不断收获知识。

definition_zh: (v) 占据；使忙碌（常考搭配：be occupied with 忙于某事）
example_sentence: She is always occupied with her study and never wastes time.
sentence_zh: 她一心投入学习，从不虚度光阴。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 提供；主动提出（常考搭配：offer to do sth 主动做某事）
example_sentence: Many students offer to help others in need.
sentence_zh: 不少同学主动帮扶有困难的人。

example_sentence: We should learn to operate basic electronic equipment.
sentence_zh: 我们要学会操作基础电子设备。

definition_zh: (v) 反对（常考搭配：be opposed to 反对）
example_sentence: Most students are opposed to endless mechanical exercises.
sentence_zh: 大部分学生反对枯燥重复的题海训练。

example_sentence: Teachers help us organize various meaningful activities.
sentence_zh: 老师协助我们举办各类有意义的活动。

example_sentence: Don’t overlook the importance of basic knowledge.
sentence_zh: 切勿忽视基础知识的重要性。

definition_zh: (v) 参与（常考搭配：participate in 参加）
example_sentence: More and more students participate in volunteer activities.
sentence_zh: 越来越多的学生投身志愿活动。

example_sentence: We should perceive our own shortcomings and improve ourselves.
sentence_zh: 我们要认清自身不足，不断完善自我。

example_sentence: Most students perform well in daily class learning.
sentence_zh: 多数学生日常课堂表现良好。

definition_zh: (v) 说服（常考搭配：persuade sb to do sth 说服某人做某事）
example_sentence: I tried to persuade my friend to give up bad habits.
sentence_zh: 我尽力劝说朋友改掉不良习惯。

example_sentence: Excellent students always possess good learning habits.
sentence_zh: 优等生普遍都有着良好的学习习惯。

example_sentence: No one can exactly predict the result of the exam.
sentence_zh: 没有人能精准预判考试成绩。

definition_zh: (v) 更喜欢；偏好（常考搭配：prefer to do sth 更喜欢做某事）
example_sentence: I prefer to study quietly in the library.
sentence_zh: 我更喜欢在图书馆静心学习。

definition_zh: (v) 准备（常考搭配：prepare for 为……做准备）
example_sentence: We are all busy preparing for the coming mid-term exam.
sentence_zh: 我们都在忙着备战即将到来的期中考试。

example_sentence: It is everyone’s duty to preserve traditional culture.
sentence_zh: 传承保护传统文化是每个人的责任。

definition_zh: (v) 假装（常考搭配：pretend to do sth 假装做某事）
example_sentence: Don’t pretend to know everything when you are confused.
sentence_zh: 不懂的时候不要故作通晓。

definition_zh: (v) 阻止；预防（常考搭配：prevent sb from doing sth 阻止某人做某事）
example_sentence: Good habits can prevent us from making stupid mistakes.
sentence_zh: 良好习惯能帮我们规避低级失误。

example_sentence: We will proceed with our study plan as scheduled.
sentence_zh: 我们将依照计划继续推进学习任务。

example_sentence: Proper rest can produce better learning results.
sentence_zh: 适度休息能收获更佳的学习效果。

example_sentence: You will progress steadily if you keep working hard.
sentence_zh: 持之以恒努力，就能稳步取得进步。

example_sentence: Sports can promote physical health and team spirit.
sentence_zh: 运动既能强健体魄，也能培养团队精神。

example_sentence: He proposed a new method to improve classroom efficiency.
sentence_zh: 他提出新办法来提升课堂学习效率。

definition_zh: (v) 保护（常考搭配：protect...from... 保护……免受……）
example_sentence: We should protect ourselves from bad external influences.
sentence_zh: 我们要守护自身，远离外界不良影响。

example_sentence: Practice has proved that persistence leads to success.
sentence_zh: 实践证明，坚持方能铸就成功。

definition_zh: (v) 提供（常考搭配：provide sb with sth 为某人提供某物）
example_sentence: Schools provide students with good learning resources.
sentence_zh: 学校为学生提供优质的学习资源。

example_sentence: Many students publish articles in school magazines.
sentence_zh: 不少学生在校刊上发表文章。

example_sentence: We can purchase useful books through online platforms.
sentence_zh: 我们可以网购实用的教辅书籍。

example_sentence: Young people should pursue their dreams with courage.
sentence_zh: 年轻人应当勇敢追逐心中的梦想。

example_sentence: Continuous efforts can qualify you for better opportunities.
sentence_zh: 不懈努力能让你把握住更好的机遇。

example_sentence: We can quote famous sentences in our English compositions.
sentence_zh: 英语作文中可以引用名人名言。

example_sentence: We should raise our awareness of independent learning.
sentence_zh: 我们要增强自主学习的意识。

definition_zh: (v) 反应（常考搭配：react to 对……做出反应）
example_sentence: Different people react differently to pressure.
sentence_zh: 不同的人面对压力反应各不相同。

example_sentence: I received lots of useful suggestions from my teachers.
sentence_zh: 我从老师那里得到许多实用建议。

example_sentence: Gradually, I recognized the importance of hard work.
sentence_zh: 我渐渐意识到勤奋努力的重要意义。

example_sentence: Teachers always recommend classic books for students to read.
sentence_zh: 老师常常推荐经典书目供学生阅读。

example_sentence: It takes time to recover from tiredness after long study.
sentence_zh: 长时间学习后的疲惫需要时间缓解。

example_sentence: We should reduce unnecessary waste of study time.
sentence_zh: 我们要减少学习时间的无谓浪费。

definition_zh: (v) 参考；提及；查阅（常考搭配：refer to 参考；查阅；提及）
example_sentence: You can refer to dictionaries when meeting new words.
sentence_zh: 遇到生词时可以查阅词典。

example_sentence: Every exam result can reflect your real learning level.
sentence_zh: 每一次考试成绩都能反映真实学习水平。

example_sentence: Education reform helps improve students’ comprehensive ability.
sentence_zh: 教育改革有助于提升学生综合素养。

definition_zh: (v) 拒绝（常考搭配：refuse to do sth 拒绝做某事）
example_sentence: We should refuse bad behaviors that affect our study.
sentence_zh: 我们要抵制影响学习的不良行为。

example_sentence: Don’t waste time, or you will regret it in the future.
sentence_zh: 切莫虚度光阴，否则日后定会心生遗憾。

example_sentence: We should regulate our study time reasonably every day.
sentence_zh: 我们每天都要合理规划学习时长。

example_sentence: We should reject lazy attitudes towards study.
sentence_zh: 我们要摒弃敷衍懒散的学习态度。

definition_zh: (v) 联系；相关（常考搭配：relate to 与……相关；理解）
example_sentence: Most reading passages relate to real social life.
sentence_zh: 多数阅读文章都贴合现实社会生活。

example_sentence: Listening to music can help us relax after busy study.
sentence_zh: 繁忙学习过后，听歌有助于舒缓身心。

example_sentence: Proper exercise can release study pressure effectively.
sentence_zh: 适度运动能有效排解学习压力。

definition_zh: (v) 依靠；依赖（常考搭配：rely on 依靠；依赖）
example_sentence: We cannot always rely on others’ help in our study.
sentence_zh: 学习中不能一味依赖他人的帮助。

example_sentence: We need to remove bad study habits step by step.
sentence_zh: 我们要一步步改掉不良学习习惯。

example_sentence: Carelessness renders many students lose marks easily.
sentence_zh: 粗心大意让很多学生白白失分。

example_sentence: We should renew our study plans at the start of each month.
sentence_zh: 每月伊始我们都要更新学习计划。

example_sentence: Some students rent quiet rooms for self-study on weekends.
sentence_zh: 部分学生周末租住安静房间自习。

example_sentence: We should repair our mistakes in time after exams.
sentence_zh: 考完试要及时查漏补缺、改正错误。

example_sentence: Repeat memorization is an effective way to remember words.
sentence_zh: 反复背诵是记单词的有效方法。

definition_zh: (v) 取代；替换（常考搭配：replace A with B 用B取代A）
example_sentence: We should replace passive learning with active learning.
sentence_zh: 我们要变被动听课为主动学习。

definition_zh: (v) &n. 回复；答复（常考搭配：reply to 回复）
example_sentence: Please reply to the teacher’s questions actively in class.
sentence_zh: 课堂上要积极回应老师的提问。

example_sentence: We need to write a report after finishing social practice.
sentence_zh: 社会实践结束后我们需要撰写报告。

example_sentence: Young students represent the hope of the future.
sentence_zh: 青年学子代表着国家未来的希望。

definition_zh: (v) 需要；要求（常考搭配：require doing/to do 需要做某事）
example_sentence: English learning requires long-term persistence and accumulation.
sentence_zh: 英语学习贵在长期坚持与日积月累。

example_sentence: Many volunteers take part in rescue training in spare time.
sentence_zh: 不少志愿者空余时间参与救援培训。

example_sentence: His learning method resembles that of top students.
sentence_zh: 他的学习方式和尖子生十分相像。

example_sentence: We should resist the temptation of mobile phones while studying.
